lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the weight of silent stars,
I walk the path of hidden fears.
The shadows stretch across the floor,
I search for light behind the door.
[Chorus]
Hold me in the hollow space,
Find the truth within my grace.
Break the chains of every doubt,
Let the inner fire shout.
[Verse]
The mountains rise in jagged lines,
Where every secret hope entwines.
A whispered prayer begins to rise,
To clear the mist before my eyes.
[Chorus]
Hold me in the hollow space,
Find the truth within my grace.
Break the chains of every doubt,
Let the inner fire shout.
[Bridge]
The world dissolves into the gray,
As I find the words to pray.
[Chorus]
Hold me in the hollow space,
Find the truth within my grace.
Break the chains of every doubt,
Let the inner fire shout.
[Outro]
